verdict.rationale: Intel's developer docs claim LLM inference optimizations for Core Ultra series 2 through oneDNN and PyTorch, and list OpenVINO and ONNX RT support. Community reviews confirm a rated DDR5-6400 memory speed and CUDIMM support. However, the pack never states maximum addressable memory or a published memory bandwidth figure, and has no evidence of a 70B-class model actually running. missing for 10: published max memory capacity, published memory bandwidth spec, hands-on evidence of 70B quantized inference throughput.
